reasons.action: The user explicitly specifies the temporal action: continue from the clip and end exactly on the picture. This request-governed action overrides any static pose in the image reference.
reasons.medium: The medium_decision preserves the reference live-action medium and no explicit transformation or target rendering instruction is present.
reasons.wardrobe: No wardrobe or object appearance change is requested, so the observed reference attributes govern and are retained.
reasons.lighting: No explicit lighting instruction is given, so lighting follows the visual references and the medium_decision preserve outcome.
reasons.framing: No explicit framing instruction is given; the requested 16:9 aspect and duration are canvas/timing configuration, not framing direction.
reasons.palette: No explicit palette instruction is given, so palette follows the visual references.
